name: Negative-funding over-short accumulation — long spot when shorts are paying a deep premium
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from funding-reset-reversion, which pairs a near-zero funding ceiling with an RSI washout; this requires a DEEPLY negative funding extreme and reads over-extension via the band z-score, not RSI — a different crowding gauge and a different threshold regime): when perp funding goes strongly NEGATIVE, perpetual SHORTS are paying LONGS a fat premium to keep their bearish bets open — a revealed, over-leveraged, one-sided SHORT crowd. Historically these negative-funding extremes precede short squeezes: the negative carry bleeds the shorts, and any bounce forces covering that accelerates the move up. A SPOT long buys into that asymmetry (no perp-short capability needed, fits the spot-only live constraint) and, with funding_feature wired, the open long is not charged carry (a long pays funding only when it is positive) — the positioning extreme IS the edge. Entry: funding_rate below a fitted deep-negative floor (over-short crowd) AND price statistically stretched to the downside (bb_z below a fitted floor — washed out, not mid-range). Exit: funding_rate crosses UP back toward zero (the short crowd is covering / carry pressure relieved) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if the unconditional bb_z washout dip-buy matches the deflated Sharpe, the funding extreme adds nothing — the edge must be the positioning, not generic oversold. Disconfirmer 2: deep-negative funding clusters in violent down-moves; if the bb_z floor doesn't keep us out of true freefall this catches knives. Disconfirmer 3: this overlaps funding-reset-reversion in spirit — if dropping bb_z for RSI gives the same result they are the same spec; the band z-score must add distinct over-extension information. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): the squeeze must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 funding feature (deep PIT data).
catalyst: deeply negative perp funding into a washed-out price — an over-short crowd a spot long squeezes
